diagnosis: Diagnostic algorithm for the integrated histomolecular endometrial carcinoma (EC) classification
legend: This algorithm can be applied for all histological endometrial cancer subtypes (including carcinosarcomas). MMR, mismatch repair; MMRd, mismatch repair–deficient; NSMP, no specific molecular profile. aPathogenic POLE variants include p.Pro286Arg, p.Val411Leu, p.Ser297Phe, p.Ala456Pro, and p.Ser459Phe {31829447; 31829442}. bMMR deficiency is defined by loss of one or more MMR proteins (MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, and MSH6). cp53 immunohistochemistry is an acceptable surrogate marker for TP53 mutation status in MMR-proficient, POLE-wildtype EC {31829441}.
